build_recipe: Core source at git tag libreoffice-26.2.6.3 (annotated tag object a42511787d93dfe0372559736ec296ff7b45702f, peeled commit 8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1, commit message 'Version 26.2.6.3, tag libreoffice-26.2.6.3', committer date 2026-09-02T15:15:18Z). Canonical repo https://git.libreoffice.org/core (cgit); mirror used for verification: https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/tree/8221e31b3ac356a1623c672912a3d2b492f7e3d1 (verified with git ls-remote 'https://github.com/LibreOffice/core' 'refs/tags/libreoffice-26.2.6.3' 'refs/tags/libreoffice-26.2.6.3^{}' -> tag a4251178..., peeled 8221e31b... and with the GitHub commits API). The TDF source release libreoffice-26.2.6.3.tar.xz is produced from that tree by bin/lo-pack-sources (present in the tarball), which repacks the core tree plus the dictionaries/helpcontent2/translations subtrees and writes sources.ver (contents: 'lo_sources_ver=26.2.6.3'). Build = standard autogen.sh/configure + make against the fetched externals; the Windows .msi and macOS .dmg listed under binaries are TDF's official builds from that tree. External dependency sources are published by TDF at https://dev-www.libreoffice.org/src/ (and https://dev-www.libreoffice.org/extern/). VERIFIED in the tree at that tag: download.lst (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LibreOffice/core/libreoffice-26.2.6.3/download.lst - byte-identical to the copy inside the release tarball) defines the external packages as 'NAME_TARBALL := <file>' paired with 'NAME_SHA256SUM := <sha256>' (152 SHA256SUM assignments, e.g. BOOST_SHA256SUM/BOOST_TARBALL := boost_1_89_0.tar.xz; also OPENSYMBOL_TTF, ODFVALIDATOR_JAR, OFFICEOTRON_JAR, plus a cargo fetch for external/y-crdt), and Makefile.fetch at the same tag (sha256 9e4ddc229915a3150ebdfb4fc3742e6efb062c6510faa71158bc230349152318, identical to the copy in the tarball) has the 'download' target depend on download.lst with fetch_Download_item aborting via 'fetch_Download_item: no checksum found for ... Please define ... in download.lst.' when a checksum is missing, downloading from https://dev-www.libreoffice.org/src (Makefile.fetch line 252) and https://dev-www.libreoffice.org/extern (line 257) and verifying the downloaded sha256. So those third-party tarballs are build-time inputs fetched from dev-www and pinned by download.lst; they are NOT covered as individual sources here.

sources.note: Exact TDF source release of core for this build. N=3 is the shipped build: https://download.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/src/26.2.6/ contains only the 26.2.6.3 tarball set (core, dictionaries, help, translations + .asc each), the archive's own sources.ver says 'lo_sources_ver=26.2.6.3', and the matching git tag libreoffice-26.2.6.3 exists in core (commit 'Version 26.2.6.3'). sha256 and size computed here by downloading the file; they match the published MirrorBrain metainfo at https://download.documentfoundation.org/libreoffice/src/26.2.6/libreoffice-26.2.6.3.tar.xz.meta4 (hash type="sha-256" 3a2570aa..., size 292347864) and the digest header served for the URL (digest: MD5=K3Kb6WWLqfRH4CpxS/Gxxg==, SHA=pi95RO2aBz/iDXv7ya+YRzrYzkM=, SHA-256=OiVwqnCHv44MvfSaxb0ORSwgJSdK+Z4HiC2qEExWhb0= ; the last decodes to the same sha256). The detached signature libreoffice-26.2.6.3.tar.xz.asc was verified with gpg: 'Good signature from "LibreOffice Build Team (CODE SIGNING KEY) <build@documentfoundation.org>"', RSA key fingerprint C2839ECAD9408FBE9531C3E9F434A1EFAFEEAEA3 (key fetched from keyserver.ubuntu.com; keys.openpgp.org serves a UID-stripped copy that gpg will not use). License taken from the sources themselves, not prose: readlicense_oo/license/license.xml is the generator of the shipped LICENSE/license.txt (see readlicense_oo/Package_license.mk) and states as the primary licence 'This product is made available subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License, v. 2.0' while enumerating the bundled third-party components under LGPL-2.1, LGPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, MPL-1.1/2.0, Apache-2.0, SIL OFL 1.1, CC-BY-SA-3.0/4.0, LPPL and CPL-1.0 (e.g. bundled libraries: liblangtag LGPL-3.0, lpsolve/cairo/libwpd/... LGPL-2.1, poppler/Hunspell/Hyphen/libcmis/Zstandard GPL-2.0, Culmus/Linux Libertine GPL-2.0, several bundled dictionaries + the Elementary icon theme GPL-3.0, Caladea and other bundled fonts Apache-2.0/OFL-1.1); the tree root carries COPYING (GPL-3.0 text), COPYING.LGPL (LGPL-3.0 text) and COPYING.MPL (MPL-2.0 text), readlicense_oo/license/NOTICE carries the Apache-2.0 notices ('Portions of LibreOffice may include work under the Apache License v2.0 requiring this NOTICE file to be provided'), and core source headers per TEMPLATE.SOURCECODE.HEADER are MPL-2.0 (MPLv2 or MPLv2-on-ALv2).

Same tree as the http tarball above (which additionally carries sources.ver and the packed subtrees); the tarball is the authoritative source pin for a source offer. Three submodules, pinned by the gitlinks in this commit and resolved with the GitHub contents API: dictionaries -> https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries @ 9925407d67e752a75cff6a1b2d7b713b7ef0380c, helpcontent2 -> https://github.com/LibreOffice/help @ e040abb737f1aeee1b30ddffdac407535033d2b6, translations -> https://github.com/LibreOffice/translations @ 767aed986038ca632ce2a7285a04f4d4b9a9c29e (see .gitmodules at the tag for the relative URLs ../dictionaries, ../help, ../translations). These subtrees are shipped as separate TDF tarballs (libreoffice-dictionaries-26.2.6.3.tar.xz, libreoffice-help-26.2.6.3.tar.xz, libreoffice-translations-26.2.6.3.tar.xz in the same src/26.2.6 directory) and are not covered as separate entries here.
